column1: # helpers of the skill classes for ids 69-101 named by the spec pass (docs/spec/skills-69-101.md). Only addresses that had no name.

column3: (f radius, spell): for each candidate the ring has reached, damage_apply with stat 0 +-20% and one Spell_rand stun roll; only caller SpellUnspokenWord_run
(skill, rank, record*, frames) -> 1 + stat0/100 * min(1, frames/60) when record hp <= half of max, else 1; also sets the flash colour of the record object; caller Player_run 0x1aa158 area
(skill, rank, record*, frames) -> 1 + stat1/100 * min(1, frames/60) when record hp <= half of max, else 1; caller Player_recalcDamage 0x1b79e0 area
(skill, level, item*, noRandomVariant): parses one of five sum*throwingaxe descriptors chosen by level and adds modifiers 0x25, 0x24, 0x0e; callers SpellSummonAxe_ctor and SkillSummonAxe_describeRank
(f radius, spell): for each candidate the wave has reached, damage_apply with stat 1 +-20%, flags by level; only caller SpellRoar_run
(spell, creature, float *out) -> 1 if the creature is the owner, or after the cry within the aura radius (same team in PvP mode A); out = stat1/100; caller Player_run 0x1aa0ac
(bolt): creates the poisonGasSpell cloud from stats 1-3 when the bolt has an owner, then 321 particles; only caller PoisonBolt_run
(spell, creature) -> 1 for a dead non-player non-boss corpse whose death clip has finished and that is not sinking, friendly or revived
(f radius, spell): re-creates each raisable corpse the ring has reached through world_createObject, charms it for 3600 frames, counts against stat 1; only caller SpellRaiseArmy_run
(f progress, spell): phase-1 particles; sets object flag 0x2 on the owner past half; own generator only
(f progress, spell): phase-3 particles; clears object flag 0x2 on the owner past half; own generator only
(f radius, spell): for each candidate the ring has reached, damage_apply with stat 1 +-20% and a 0x15 slot of 10, flags 0x160; only caller SpellWaveOfFlame_run
(f damage, spell, attacker) -> factor 1 - stat1/100 (floor 0); with an attacker draws g_randSeed and on stat 2 percent strikes back with a 0x16 slot; called by damage_apply
